import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import ActionApp from '@src/response-apps/soulPath/action/app';
import ChooseApp from '@src/response-apps/soulPath/choose/app';
import { parseSoulPathInput } from '@src/response-apps/soulPath/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
import { addSoulQuote, getCommandArgument, sendSoulGui } from './shared';

export const createSoulPreviewHandler = (action: 'choose' | 'switch' | 'advance' | 'reroll', command: string) => onResponse(selects, async e => {
    const [message] = useMessage();
    const target = parseSoulPathInput(getCommandArgument(e.MessageText, command));
    const result =
      action === 'choose'
        ? !target
          ? { success: false as const, message: '请选择玄法、炼体或御器。' }
          : await ChooseApp({ bid: e.UserId, uid: e.uid as number, pathKey: target, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) })
        : action === 'switch' && !target
          ? { success: false as const, message: '请选择玄法、炼体或御器。' }
          : await ActionApp({ bid: e.UserId, uid: e.uid as number, action, pathKey: target, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    for (const [index, line] of (result.success ? result.data.message : result.message).split('\n').entries()) {
      if (index === 0) {
        md.addBold(line);
        md.addNewline();
      } else {
        addSoulQuote(md, line);
      }
    }
    await message.send(
      sendSoulGui(e, `${command}·确认`, md, [
        ...(result.success ? [{ label: '确认执行', command: `/确认神魂 ${action === 'choose' ? `choose:${result.data.token}` : result.data.token}` }] : []),
        { label: '返回道途', command: '/元婴道途' },
        { label: '材料来源', command: '/神魂材料来源' }
      ])
    );
  });
